title: Robot teaching conveyor
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Move the stop sensor upstream.
physical_check: Run the 80 g article through 100 passes at each speed and measure the longest stop, including a slipping belt.

title: Compliant puck singulator
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Set the adjustable gate with a single and a double coupon.
physical_check: Feed 100 actual mixed pucks. Record doubles, bridge jams and single exits at the tolerance limits.

title: Chute colour sorting head
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Move the diverter far enough beyond the read line.
physical_check: Run two randomized sets of 100 real parts in the intended lighting, scoring wrong bins separately from late gate movements.

title: Teaching robot odometry pod
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Calibrate the rolling distance per encoder turn.
physical_check: Tape a 2 m baseline, measure actual loaded circumference and record forward and reverse error on three floor finishes.

title: Short-stroke gate pusher
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Place the limit before the deceleration zone.
physical_check: Cycle a 250 g dummy 500 times and record worst overrun, endpoint spread and home response.

title: Line-track teaching cart
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Check where seven reflectance sensors lose the line.
physical_check: Replay the figure-eight for ten laps under declared lighting, including how the cart chooses its path at the crossing.

title: Machine vision calibration board
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Detect a printed-scale ChArUco pattern after perspective distortion.
physical_check: Measure pitch at five points per axis and both diagonal flatness readings, recording gauge uncertainty.

title: Camera calibration target tripod cradle
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Size the jaw opening and pivot preload.
physical_check: Fit both board thicknesses and measure angular creep after 30 minutes under the maximum eccentric load.

title: Pan-tilt inspection camera head
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Raise the tilt pivot to clear the camera sweep.
physical_check: Sweep 250 reversals with the specified dummy module and cable, measuring clearance and return angle.

title: Robot contact bumper strip
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Reduce trigger travel until a center press registers.
physical_check: Press and release at ten positions plus center for ten cycles and record force, switch transitions and any sticking.

title: Bolt-on robot bumper corner set
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Keep both bolt washers clear of the bumper pad.
physical_check: Fit the four corners to the named extrusion, verify nut seating and check retention after representative knocks.

title: Vacuum picking head for a teaching arm
engineering: Digital engineering screen. Size the suction cup for a nonporous coupon.
physical_check: Perform 100 lifts of a 50 g coupon in a contained bin and measure release delay, leakage and power-loss response.
